_note: PLACEHOLDER recruitment and army tuning. Every number here is a tunable placeholder, not approved balance. Rules (constitution, Economy and settlements; Battles and armies): recruitment draws directly from the settlement's population; disbanded survivors return to population; replenishment is automatic in friendly regions without population cost and faster in populous regions, and costs gold in enemy territory. core/armies.gd applies these values. Unit size, cost and recruitment time are in data/units/*.json.

recruitment._note: An army can recruit at its own settlement when garrisoned there or within adjacent_radius meters of it. Units come from that settlement's buildings (unlocks) and population, which may not fall below min_population. Gold and men are taken when a unit is queued; cancelling refunds both in full.

army_cap._note: PLACEHOLDER, TW-style: at most max_units cards per army, the general included, queued units counted. The constitution rejects the earlier 6-10 cap; 20 stands until the army performance test sets a real budget.

replenishment._note: Per End Turn, each unit regains a fraction of its max strength. Friendly region (owned by the army's faction): friendly_rate plus up to populous_bonus scaled by the region settlement's population over populous_reference; no population cost. Any other region (no diplomacy yet, so every foreign or unowned region counts as enemy territory): enemy_rate, paid at enemy_gold_per_man; skipped if the treasury cannot pay.

armies._note: Raising a new army hires a general for general_cost gold at one of the faction's settlements. The maximum number of armies per faction is OPEN in the constitution; max_per_faction is a placeholder. Generals' names are generated from data/names.json (STUB until the character and family system exists).

ai._note: PLACEHOLDER AI: each AI faction keeps one defensive garrison army at its capital (its most populous settlement): it raises one there if it has none, then recruits the cheapest available unit until the army has garrison_units units, at most max_recruits_per_turn per turn, only while gold stays above reserve_gold and net income stays non-negative after the new upkeep. AI armies do not move.
